name: Plainstrider Kidney
summary: Across the Barrens, hunters harvest Plainstrider Kidney for Kalimdor's unusual brewing traditions. The organ is unappetizing to most travelers, yet essential to an exotic brew.

sections.title: An Unorthodox Brewing Ingredient
sections.body: The vast, arid plains of the Barrens are home to tall, flightless plainstriders. Hunters often take their feathers and meat for tools and simple rations, while Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks their internal organs for another purpose. Drohn says plainstrider kidneys are needed to recreate Chen Stormstout's legendary potent ale. He claims the kidneys give the brew a unique kick, in a tradition passed down through an unconventional line of brewmasters.

faq.q: What is a Plainstrider Kidney used for?
aliases: why do i need plainstrider kidneys
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet needs plainstrider kidneys to recreate a legendary batch of Stormstout ale. He says his mentor learned the recipe directly from Chen Stormstout, the wandering pandaren Brewmaster.

faq.q: Why would someone brew ale with animal organs?
faq.answer: Kalimdor's exotic brews often use parts from rugged local wildlife to give them strong, memorable flavors and distinct kicks. Brewmaster Drohn says making such potent, wild recipes reminds him fondly of unorthodox creations like trogg brew.
Various species of plainstriders that run across the Barrens yield these kidneys, including fleeting, ornery, and greater plainstriders.

faq.q: What other ingredients are needed alongside the kidneys?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn asks for five plainstrider kidneys, five savannah lion tusks, and one thunder lizard horn to complete his concoction.

angles.text: As a cook, you may balk at fermenting avian kidneys into fine spirits. In Kalimdor's wilderness, survival often means making full use of every part of the kill.
As a hunter, you must dress plainstriders carefully across the savanna to keep their internal organs intact for trade with Ratchet's brewmasters.
